page.overview:
Who is Bluud?

is a minotaur bodyguard of Marion Lavorre. He protected Marion at the Lavish Chateau in Nicodranas since her daughter Jester was a baby, and he continues to serve as her guard decades later. He was often found at his watch post outside of Marion's door when Jester and the rest of the Mighty Nein visited the Chateau.

As an NPC, Bluud is played by Matthew Mercer.

Bluud is a massive, dual-horned minotaur with thick fur. In The Mighty Nein Origins: Jester Lavorre, he is depicted with brown fur, lighter brown hair, and dark brown horns like that of Cape buffalo, and he wears his hair and a goatee in braids.

When Mighty Nein met him in , he wore a very fine shirt and no pants. In The Mighty Nein Origins, he wore a studded leather garment similar to a bases around his waist but no shirt. He has a septum and nipple piercings, in which he wears gold rings, and wears two golden bangle bracelets on each wrist and one on each bicep.
